summary: Learn to commission bias audits, review human oversight, and report AI accountability. Explore the course and practical curriculum.
lede: AI bias auditing helps non-technical leaders scrutinize AI-enabled decisions without building models. The course covers commissioning audits, interpreting demographic parity and equalized odds results, reviewing explanation evidence, and defining human review and escalation responsibilities. Executives, HR leaders, board and audit committee members, and risk professionals practise documenting oversight and preparing AI accountability reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for leaders who approve, oversee, or audit AI-enabled decisions and need to challenge evidence without coding or building models.
